tool_args.rationale: The seven observations span substrate and gradient values and support numerical fitting of the recalled smooth saturating sink-gradient mechanism. Fresh confirmation is needed to test extrapolation, especially beyond the observed gradient range.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch observations show a strong decreasing gradient dependence, inconsistent with the substrate-only Haldane form and not naturally described by the recalled Cobb-Douglas form.
All observed gradients are below the recalled threshold range, so the threshold and avalanche strength cannot be identified from these data.
The remaining ambiguity concerns the high-gradient branch, not trajectory resolution; this probe is not described as targeting that regime.
